info.title: YoutrackConsole
info.description: Out-of-the-box developer CLI for YouTrack: issues, search, comments, attachments, boards, sprints, and activity history.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: CLI client for the YouTrack REST API. Supports issue CRUD, comments, search, attachments, boards, sprints, projects, tags, and activity history. All commands accept --format (text|json|csv) and --json/--json-file for structured input.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Write diagnostic messages to standard error.

options.name: --json
options.description: JSON object with command parameters. Use '-' to read from stdin.

options.name: --json-file
options.description: Path to a UTF-8 JSON file with command parameters. Prefer this over --json when the payload contains non-ASCII characters (diacritics, bullets, em dashes), since host shells may lossy-encode piped stdin or inline JSON arguments.

commands.name: issue
commands.description: Issue operations: get, create, update, delete, search, attach files, manage attachments, link issues, run commands, and view history.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Show issue details including summary, description, custom fields, and links.

arguments.name: ISSUE_ID
arguments.description: Issue readable id or database id.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a new issue in a project with summary and optional description.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update a single issue field (summary, description, State, Priority, Assignee, etc.).

options.name: --field
options.description: Field name (summary, description, State, Priority, Assignee).

arguments.name: ISSUE_ID
arguments.description: Issue readable id or database id.

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Permanently delete an issue. This action cannot be undone.

arguments.name: ISSUE_ID
arguments.description: Issue readable id or database id.

commands.name: attach
commands.description: Upload a file attachment to an issue.

options.name: --file
options.description: Path to the file to attach.

arguments.name: ISSUE_ID
arguments.description: Issue readable id or database id.

commands.name: attachments
commands.description: List and download file attachments on issues.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all attachments on an issue with name, size, type, and author.

arguments.name: ISSUE_ID
arguments.description: Issue readable id or database id.

commands.name: download
commands.description: Download an attachment by name to a local file.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path (defaults to attachment name).

arguments.name: ISSUE_ID
arguments.description: Issue readable id or database id.

commands.name: link
commands.description: Manage issue relationships (relates to, parent for, depends on, etc.).

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a relationship to another issue.

options.name: --type
options.description: Relationship label, such as 'relates to' or 'parent for'.

options.name: --target
options.description: Target issue readable id or database id.

arguments.name: ISSUE_ID
arguments.description: Issue readable id or database id.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove a relationship to another issue.

options.name: --type
options.description: Relationship label, such as 'relates to' or 'parent for'.

options.name: --target
options.description: Target issue readable id or database id.

arguments.name: ISSUE_ID
arguments.description: Issue readable id or database id.

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search issues using YouTrack query syntax. Supports --format csv for export.

commands.name: command
commands.description: Execute a YouTrack command on one or more issues (e.g. 'State Done', 'tag MyTag', 'Assignee me').

options.name: --command
options.description: YouTrack command string (e.g. "State Duplicate tag consolidated").

arguments.name: ISSUE_IDS
arguments.description: One or more issue ids, comma-separated (e.g. ACME-1002,ACME-1019).

commands.name: history
commands.description: Show the full activity log for an issue: field changes, comments, links, and attachments.

arguments.name: ISSUE_ID
arguments.description: Issue readable id or database id.

commands.name: comment
commands.description: Add, list, update, and delete comments on issues.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a comment.

arguments.name: ISSUE_ID
arguments.description: Issue readable id or database id.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List comments (first page).

arguments.name: ISSUE_ID
arguments.description: Issue readable id or database id.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update a comment.

arguments.name: ISSUE_ID
arguments.description: Issue readable id or database id.

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a comment.

arguments.name: ISSUE_ID
arguments.description: Issue readable id or database id.

commands.name: board
commands.description: Agile board operations: list sprints and query sprint issues.

commands.name: sprints
commands.description: List sprints for the board.

options.name: --latest
options.description: Only show the latest relevant sprint: current sprint if present, otherwise the newest non-archived sprint.

commands.name: issues
commands.description: List issues from the selected sprint (first page).

options.name: --current-sprint-only
options.description: Only list issues from the active current sprint. Do not fall back to another non-archived sprint.

commands.name: user
commands.description: User operations: identify current user and list your sprint tickets.

commands.name: me
commands.description: Show the current authenticated user.

commands.name: tickets
commands.description: List your unresolved tickets across visible boards (current sprint, with fallback to latest).

commands.name: project
commands.description: Project operations: list all accessible YouTrack projects.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all accessible projects.

commands.name: tag
commands.description: Tag operations: list all accessible issue tags.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all accessible tags.
